quotations.old_english: Se gelýfeda ætwint ðám frecednyssum ðǽra deóflicra costnunga

sub_senses.meaning: with acc., cf. ge-lífan; II. 1 a α

quotations.old_english: Sum man . . . swíðe gelýfed on þone lyfiendan God
Sum mǽden . . . on ðone Hǽlend gelýfed
Cómon his ágene landleóde gelýfede (-leóf-, v. l.) on God

sub_senses.meaning: with dat., cf. ge-lífan; II. 1 a β

quotations.old_english: Sume sǽdon þ-bar; hí wǽran on Críste gelýfede

source_text: ge-lífed. Take here ge-lýfed in Dict., and add: endowed with belief, believing:--Se gelýfeda ætwint ðám frecednyssum ðǽra deóflicra costnunga, Hml. Th. i. 368, 32. Hwónlíce gelýfede menn men of little faith, 566, 28. ¶ believing on, (1) with acc., cf. ge-lífan; II. 1 a α:--Sum man . . . swíðe gelýfed on þone lyfiendan God, Ælfc. T. Grn. 11, 5. Sum mǽden . . . on ðone Hǽlend gelýfed, Hml. S. 7, 7. Cómon his ágene landleóde gelýfede (-leóf-, v. l.) on God, 14, 172. (2) with dat., cf. ge-lífan; II. 1 a β:--Sume sǽdon þ-bar; hí wǽran on Críste gelýfede, Hml. S. 2, 303. v. riht-, un-gelífed; cf. be-lífed.
